templates.why_chosen: Baseline tree (a) and OCS-mediated topology (b) share one legend and icon set that also covers a bonus (c) panel detailing the OCS's own time-varying state, extending the shared-legend rule past the contrastive pair.
templates.what_to_learn: Put a single legend of small coloured icons above all panels so it covers both the contrasted (a)/(b) topologies and a third detail panel; keep the icons visually distinct, since this figure's weakness is several similar small icons that need close reading.

templates.why_chosen: Named in the reference as the three-data-centre-networks exemplar with one legend row: (a) static tree, (b) reconfigurable OCS graph, and (c) the OCS's own time-varying state share one cyan/gray/gold icon set spanning all three panels.
templates.what_to_learn: Put one legend row above all three panels rather than repeating it per panel, and let a third panel depart from the first two's topology style to show internal behavior over time, as long as it reuses the same colour vocabulary; keep legend icons visually distinct, since similar small icons here need close reading.
